description.value: Jubilee Cycle is a South Burnaby institution founded in 1946, operated by the Davies family since 1974 — a family with deep competitive cycling roots including Olympic representation at the 1956 Melbourne Games. The shop has been voted Best Bike Shop in Burnaby for over 20 years by the Burnaby Now Newspaper and is staffed by a small team of experienced senior technicians. Conveniently located between Metrotown and Royal Oak SkyTrain stations, it serves road cyclists, mountain bikers, commuters, and touring riders alike.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (3 spaces) at 9m; stands (3 spaces) at 9m; stands (8 spaces) at 44m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and rich. The service page explicitly lists 'Box Bike for Shipping' confirming bike boxing/packing. Parts & accessories brands include Axiom, Blackburn, MKS, SKS, and Schwalbe — all well-known touring-oriented brands — confirming touring parts stocked. The full service shop with named senior technicians and a public services menu (no appointment requirement listed for standard services) supports walk-in repairs and staff mechanical help. OSM lists the community as 'Vancouver' but the website consistently places the address in Burnaby.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Vancouver' but the business address is in Burnaby (confirmed by website: '4816 Imperial Street, Burnaby, B.C V5J 1C4'); OSM address field should be updated to include city and postal code.

Website footer references a '2022 Covid-19 Return Policy', suggesting portions of the site have not been updated recently; however, current 2025/26 bike inventory is present, indicating the business is active.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Long-established, actively trading full-service bike shop with experienced technicians, touring-relevant parts inventory, and bike boxing service — clearly valuable to touring cyclists passing through the Burnaby/Greater Vancouver area.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Parts & accessories page lists Axiom (panniers/racks), Blackburn (racks/bags), MKS (touring pedals), SKS (fenders), Topeak (touring accessories), and Schwalbe (touring tires) among stocked brands

Bike boxes / packing.detail: Service page explicitly lists 'Box Bike for Shipping' as an available service
